cause.what_happened: AIFU gapped up 2.8% and then fell 24.3% intraday to the 15:05 ET screen on 2.43x normal volume (about $754k), a new 52-week low. No 6-K, press release or wire item dated 2026-09-22 was found. The most likely background is continued selling of the Class A after the 2026-09-09 6-K, which disclosed 10,000,000 Class B shares to be issued to Expansion Group at par (US$0.002, US$20,000 in total), leaving Expansion with 63.37% of all shares and 99.43% of the votes. That is context and does not show why the stock fell today.
